checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: Initial square image shows robot at recognisable train station
must.why: Platform, train, tracks, lamp, station building all present.

must.item: Round teal body, exactly one large amber eye, red boots, yellow mailbag in all three
must.why: All three robots have TWO amber eyes, not one. Teal body, red boots, yellow bag are correct.
Same body, side earpieces, cheeks, boots and bag; minor proportion variation (shorter legs, body in image 2).

must.item: One follow-up parcel at cottage door; other sheltering under giant mushroom with rain
must.why: Image 2 holds a parcel at a cottage door; image 3 shows her under a giant mushroom in visible rain.

must.item: Three separate square pictures, consistent style, no text
must.why: Style is consistent and square, but image 1 has a sign at top-left with garbled lettering-like marks, so text is present.

exact_text.read_as: Garbled sign text at top-left of image 1 (looks like 'PIBNG')

faults.what: Robot has two eyes in all three images instead of the requested single large amber eye
Garbled sign lettering on the station sign in image 1, despite 'no text'
Minor design drift: body and leg proportions vary between images; a small door plaque and doormat pattern appear in image 2

summary: The three images are consistent, attractive storybook scenes that match the settings, but the robot has two eyes instead of one and image 1 has a garbled sign, which breaks the brief.
